description: Open the person's Field Desk: a board of what they have out in the field, offers waiting on their answer, the last thread you named, their style notes, and their topics. Use it when they ask to see where things stand. Read-only for you; on hosts with interactive cards the desk lets them answer offers itself. Takes no arguments.
